_description: SAVVYDFIR-MCP case manifest template. Replace all placeholder values. This file is read by the MCP server via evidence.load_manifest() and by the agent at case start.
_instructions: Remove all '_comment' fields before use in production.
investigation_goal: {{INVESTIGATION_GOAL — one sentence describing what the agent must determine}}

disk_images._comment: Add one entry per disk image. Duplicate this block for additional hosts.

memory_dumps._comment: Add one entry per memory dump. Duplicate this block for additional hosts.

target_time_window.source: {{TIMEWINDOW_SOURCE — e.g., 'Help desk ticket opened 2026-04-30T13:00:00Z', 'Firewall alert at 14:22 UTC'}}
target_time_window._comment: UTC ISO-8601. Set to null if unknown: 'target_time_window': null

known_iocs._comment: All lists may be empty ([]) if no IOCs are known at case open. Add entries as discovered.

network_topology._comment: Provide as much topology context as available. The agent uses this to classify network connections as internal vs. external and to identify lateral movement.

prior_investigation_notes: {{FREEFORM_TEXT — prior findings, analyst observations, context from help desk, SIEM alerts. Set to null if none.}}

output_paths._comment: Do not change these values. They must match the write_paths in settings.json.

agent_config._comment: autonomous:true means the agent will not ask questions during the investigation. max_iterations caps the triage loop. severity_threshold controls which contradiction severity levels block completion.
